Düsseldorf ( German: [ˈdʏsl̩dɔʁf] ⓘ ) [ a ] is the capital city of North Rhine-Westphalia , the most populous state of Germany . It is the second-largest city in the state after Cologne and the sixth-largest city in Germany , [ b ] with a 2024 population of 618,685. [ 7 ] Most of Düsseldorf lies on the right bank of the Rhine , and the city has grown together with Neuss , Krefeld , Hilden , Langenfeld , Ratingen , Meerbusch , Dormagen , Erkrath , Solingen and Monheim . Düsseldorf is the central city of Rhine-Ruhr , the second biggest metropolitan region by GDP in the European Union, that stretches from Bonn via Cologne and Düsseldorf to the Ruhr .
